name: Memory
description: Registers task, experience, fact, and skill memory capabilities, including typed memory stores, auditable context, and memory tools.

capabilities.name: task-memory
capabilities.description: Registers the task memory store and task memory tools.

capabilities.name: skill-memory
capabilities.description: Registers the skill memory store and skill distillation pipeline.

capabilities.name: experience-memory
capabilities.description: Registers the experience memory store and experience memory tools.

capabilities.name: fact-memory
capabilities.description: Registers the fact memory store and fact memory tools.

capabilities.name: skill-memory
capabilities.description: Exposes skill-memory audit files as agent context.

capabilities.name: task-memory-tools
capabilities.description: Injects task memory tools into the agent tool set.

capabilities.name: experience-memory-tools
capabilities.description: Injects experience memory tools into the agent tool set.

capabilities.name: fact-memory-tools
capabilities.description: Injects fact memory tools into the agent tool set.

properties.name: task.enabled
properties.description: Whether task memory should register its store and tools.

properties.name: skill.enabled
properties.description: Whether skill memory should register its store and hooks.

properties.name: experience.enabled
properties.description: Whether experience memory should register its store and tools.

properties.name: fact.enabled
properties.description: Whether fact memory should register its store and tools.

properties.name: skill.useMemories
properties.description: Whether skill memory retrieval should be injected into runtime context.

properties.name: skill.generateMemories
properties.description: Whether runtime evidence should produce skill memory artifacts.

properties.name: skill.memoryRoot
properties.description: Filesystem root for skill memory artifacts.
